purpose: Supplemental semantic counterexamples selected from static prototype review before execution; frozen32 remains unchanged

cases.query: USA total energy consumption; do not include all coal production.
cases.reason: Negating complete inclusion is not a full data exclusion; the permitted subset is unspecified.

cases.query: USA total energy consumption; do not include only coal production.
cases.reason: Negates exclusive inclusion; does not entail coal omission.

cases.query: USA total energy consumption; I'm not sure whether coal production belongs here.
cases.reason: Coal production is an undecided addition, whether or not a whitelisted request action is used.

cases.query: USA total energy consumption; I'm not certain that Canada coal production is wanted.
cases.reason: Uncertainty about wanting a second request must not promote its country and pair.

cases.query: I'm not sure of the label, please show USA total energy consumption.
cases.reason: The command is independently affirmative, not an undecided whether-to-include clause.

cases.query: I'm not sure of the label — show USA total energy consumption.
cases.reason: Em dash separates an affirmative command from a certainty comment.

cases.query: USA energy consumption, not coal production, and give Canada natural gas consumption.
cases.reason: A fresh affirmative request must terminate the earlier exclusion regardless of the exact request verb.

cases.query: USA total energy consumption; do not include coal production unless natural gas consumption is unavailable.
cases.reason: Conditional inclusion policy is not an unconditional exclusion or positive request; clarify unsupported condition.
